integrity.method: SHA-256 recomputed with hashlib. Pillow checked stored/display dimensions and EXIF. All eighteen distinct whole PNG states opened at original resolution.

visualReasons: The ordinary rail now reads as a small timing track with one head; families and destination digits appear in the single forecast row. The native star field retains priority and continuous scenery.
The head remains identifiable at left, near-right and right-end positions, including Calm and actual system Reduce Motion. Normal glow/particles remain subordinate to the track and forecast.
Complete 4/5/6, 2/3 and repeated 1/1/1/6/6 forecast facts remain distinct. Arriving versus Next is classified from visible pixels rather than attachment names.
Pause, Help where present, score and paused controls stay complete and separate. Sunny, Spark and Nova text fits in the pictured bubbles with complete final phrases.
Automatic-cycle stills show bodies at distinct heights and later fuller fields without collision between the forecast and timing rail. These stills do not establish unseen animation continuity.
limits: Twenty-seven sparse samples show the pictured state ordering and visually stable heads in two sampled paused windows. They do not establish continuous smoothness, exact cadence, unseen intervals, full pause duration or performance.

Normal raw/decoded pixels witness Arriving at the right endpoint. Calm and system Reduce Motion committed-named stills show refreshed Next; Calm decoded footage also goes from near-end approach to refreshed Next in the selected samples. No quiet p=1/Arriving dwell is pictured or claimed.
Pacing Calm and actual system Reduce Motion are legitimate separate requested contrasts. Their raw receipts report true/false and false/true respectively; neither replaces normal-motion acceptance.
No native island path was exercised here; preserved source/sampler checks are not painted native geometry proof.
No native AX5 phone, platform focus, disabled touch, Increased Contrast, Reduced Transparency, actual VoiceOver, minimum-iOS or physical-device comfort/performance acceptance follows from this scope.
No contrast ratio, target size, rule, save, receipt timing or clock invariant is inferred from these pixels. Mechanical source-bound results remain separately owned.
Final JPEG-export acceptance and global Goal 5 adoption remain separately owned; this review supplies bounded Pacing/cycle native acceptance only.

Actual system Reduce Motion was independently verified in its still/text receipts; no system Reduce Motion movie was decoded. Calm motion samples remain a distinct mode. H264-decoded samples are not source RGB contrast evidence.

phaseConclusions: Normal actual 25.3, 27.483333, 28.993333 and 30.696667 show successive left-to-right positions before the 31.883333 Arriving endpoint. At 32.793333 the Sky menu hides the rail; 35.195 shows the later paused near-left head with next 2, 3. No direct flight/reset latency is inferred across that gap.

Calm actual 24.993333 through 30.496667 show a visible pearl head at successive quiet positions without normal glow/dust. At 31.698333 the next 2, 3 forecast and reset head are already visible. These sparse positions are consistent with the source quiet updates but do not prove a particular stepping cadence or an Arriving dwell.

Normal cycles show different successive forecasts and arrivals, including actual bodies/trails in flight and repeated ordered destinations. This confirms pictured repeated-cycle states, not every frame of each cycle.

Actual 44.096667, 44.796667 and 45.196667 all visibly show Resume sky with the same head/forecast 1, 1, 1, 6, 6. Actual 56.893333, 57.393333 and 57.891667 show a later paused head/forecast 3, 3, 3, 2, 2. Both roughly one-second sampled windows are visually stable; no absolute pause-duration claim follows.
Actual 52.298333 is resumed Arriving 1, 1, 1, 6, 6; 53.19 is the Sky menu. The latter is explicitly excluded from running-rail observations.
sampledMotion.limits: Nominal wall-clock labels locate candidates only. Classification follows exact observed frame contents and AV actual timestamps. No continuous playback, physical touch, exact event latency, all-cycle continuity or sustained-performance verdict.
